items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 31:1
items.html: (To the question) Only the Mochin of face to face are drawn from the head of ZA, as the Rav wrote above in Item 138, see there. But the Mochin of the separation, which come in the back, are drawn from Aba and Ima themselves, equally with the Mochin of ZA.
